Aline: Quick syncWe need a tight landing update for next week's micro-launch. Objective: one demo CTA, clear tri-mode hero (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), and simple lead tagging. Timeline: wire copy by EOD, design by noon tomorrow, push hero variant Wed 9am.

Manny: Good. Keep variants minimal. Single CTA makes ops easier.

Jamie: Draft hero lines: Hosted: "Start building with low-friction inference". Dedicated: "Predictable capacity for production". Private: "Private deployment, enterprise controls". Each <=7 words.

Sophie: I'll draft two benchmark blurbs: landing and social. Landing: "Production-grade latency and consistent economics across hosted, dedicated, or private deployments." Social: "Predictable latency and cost for LLM inference. Webinar Thu 10am." Also a one-line webinar promo: "Run inference reliably across hosted, dedicated, and private modes."

Tom: Routing plan: single form with mode selector -> CRM tag. Rules: if private -> enterprise-AE, elif dedicated -> capacity-team, else -> growth-inbound. Will add utm_campaign=microlaunch.

Rei: I'll run a 48h placement A/B: hero vs inline demo box. Instrument event `cta_click` with props `mode` and `variant`. Need final hero copy by EOD to wire.

launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar "Production inference patterns" Thu 10:00. Current signups: 6.

Aline: Owners recap: Jamie copy, Sophie benchmarks & blurbs, Manny social schedule, Tom routing, Rei tracking. Reconvene 4pm for final signoff. :rocket:
